# squeeze_sauce_bottle

Evidence: f5281. See `spec.json` for source crop boxes and raw point/edge observations; `../measurements.json` retains metric point and rectangle measurements.

Geometry is a parametric fit to visible contours. Nominal local dimensions: [0.068, 0.068, 0.166] m; evaluated bounds: [0.0682, 0.0682, 0.166] m. Curved-object sizes use inventory/product-scale priors checked against depth; crop boundaries often include occlusion and must not be treated as metric silhouettes. Hidden backs, wall thicknesses, pivots, closure threads, and mass are assumptions.

Each instance stores its own observed frame and estimated bottom centre. Raw depth lies on the visible surface; registration offsets it toward the hidden centre using an assumed half-depth and subtracts half the height. Yaw is inferred from shelf/door alignment, not fitted from full object tracking. This is offline registration, not online pose estimation. Reported approximately 4% depth uncertainty is compounded by crop, occlusion and centroid error (roughly 4–7 cm or more). Do not combine moving-door observations at different times without a parent transform.

Visual parts: body, cap. 170 convex collision pieces retain the main container opening where applicable. Thin-wall hull sectors and rectangular grids approximate curved inner corners. Soft items provide tentative constitutive parameters under physics.deformable and a rigid contact fallback; no soft-body or fluid rollout has been validated. Closed containers require their separate closure collider attached. Screw caps have coupled rotational/axial controls; press-fit lids and stoppers use removal guides and become free bodies on release. Joint ranges are assumed, not observed limits.

Photo textures preserve visible print and lighting. They are not calibrated intrinsic albedo; roughness/metallic/transmission are material priors. Unknown rear label regions use a flat sampled colour. Use `material_variants` to substitute photo/closure materials and scale repeated instances. glTF contains the representative material; variant source maps and Blender datablocks are supplied. Generated can-front restoration and pulp texture are declared in ../review/texture_generation.md; other incomplete print remains photographed evidence.

Mass 0.354 kg and the material-specific physics parameters are unmeasured priors; see physics for justification, ranges and deformability. Mesh triangle count 18620; collision pieces 170. Model has no hidden support plane in exports. Original studio previews are archived; current render_0.png and render_1.png use the calibrated cameras below.
